description: Source code for 'otrx' utility handling TRX firmware images, including functions for checking, creating, and extracting TRX files, with CRC32 checksum calculations and endianness handling.

methods.name: otrx_crc32
methods.description: Calculates CRC32 checksum over a buffer using a lookup table.

methods.name: otrx_check_parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for the check operation.

methods.name: otrx_check
methods.description: Checks if a given file is a valid TRX image by verifying magic, length, and CRC32.

methods.name: otrx_create_append_file
methods.description: Appends the contents of a file to the TRX output file.

methods.name: otrx_create_append_zeros
methods.description: Appends zeros to the TRX file to reach a specified length.

methods.name: otrx_create_align
methods.description: Aligns the current offset in the TRX file to a specified boundary by appending zeros.

methods.name: otrx_create_write_hdr
methods.description: Writes the TRX header to the file, calculating CRC32 over the data.

methods.name: otrx_create
methods.description: Creates a new TRX file with specified partitions and options.

methods.name: otrx_extract_parse_options
methods.description: Parses command-line options for the extract operation.

methods.name: otrx_extract_copy
methods.description: Copies a partition from the TRX file to an output file.

methods.name: otrx_extract
methods.description: Extracts specified partitions from a TRX file.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the utility.
